versions.changelog:
alvis-adaptive-suite 1.0.0

- Initial release of an adaptive skill suite for Clawdbot, combining capabilities in coding, project management, business analysis, web/data development, and NAS metadata scraping.
- Integrates with SkillBoss API Hub to discover and recommend free/open-source resources across 100+ AI services.
- Adapts to user context and preferences in coding style, project management, and data workflows.
- Ensures reliable, best-practice guidance by referencing proven methodologies and cross-checking outputs.
- Provides a safe, read-only NAS metadata scraping tool as a local desktop app.
